detailed_descriptions.en: Some of You May Die is a strategic autobattler where you assemble a team of heroes and upgrade them to absurd levels of power. Take on the singleplayer campaign or test your skill against other players in Real-time Online PvP! Breaking the game IS the game. Stack upgrades and heroes to level them up. Invest gold in customizing your heroes with full control over their stat sheet. Want a high armor priest who reflects incoming damage? You can do that. How about an assassin with lightning fast movement speed who skips your opponents defensive line entirely? Yup. No two heroes are the same! Every time you are offered a hero, they come with a different combination of Boosted Stats and an Ability that give them a unique edge. These combinations create a huge amount of variety. After choosing a hero, you are offered dozens of highly synergistic upgrades to push the customization even farther. This empowers you to create ultra-powerful teams that feel completely unstoppable - until your opponent reaches for the perfect counter. Key Features Multiplayer and Singleplayer: Test your skill in Real-time Online PvP or beat the singleplayer campaign with 7 different squads and 5 difficulty levels A Constantly Shifting Meta-Game: Each match has a different pool of upgrades to pick from and multiplayer games offer you a randomized squad of heroes too. This keeps the meta-strategy fresh every time you play! Deep Customization: Each hero comes with 2 Boosted Stats (like health, attack speed, or range) and an ability. Boosted Stats start higher and upgrade faster than a non-boosted stat. This means that each hero offered in the shop has unique potential and some can be upgraded to absurd levels of power. Become Overpowered: Stack heroes of the same kind from the shop to level them up. Leveled heroes get a significant boost to their stats, making each level a meaningful step up. Invest heavily in one or two powerful heroes or go wide and flood the battlefield to outnumber your foes! The choice is yours. Stack your Upgrades: Level up your heroes' upgrades too! Upgrades offer a high variety of customization. Some add effects to your heroes' attacks like Poison or Stun. Some trigger actions on events like "on death" or "on kill". Leveled upgrades become significantly more powerful which leads to highly strategic and specialized builds. Dynamic Difficulty: In singleplayer, if you lose a round, you lose a life, but you get to try the same round again with additional gold. This ensures new players get up to speed comfortably while still providing an exciting challenge for seasoned players. Matches are tactical, exciting, and will have you on the edge of your seat right up to the end! PvP matches often involve multiple "come backs" as the losing player gains traction and puts the winning player at risk.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Some of You May Die is a strategic autobattler where you assemble a team of heroes and upgrade them to absurd levels of power.  Take on the singleplayer campaign or test your skill against other players in Real-time Online PvP!

Breaking the game IS the game.  Stack upgrades and heroes to level them up.  Invest gold in customizing your heroes with full control over their stat sheet.

Want a high armor priest who reflects incoming damage? You can do that.
How about an assassin with lightning fast movement speed who skips your opponents defensive line entirely? Yup.

No two heroes are the same! Every time you are offered a hero, they come with a different combination of Boosted Stats and an Ability that give them a unique edge.  These combinations create a huge amount of variety.  After choosing a hero, you are offered dozens of highly synergistic upgrades to push the customization even farther.  This empowers you to create ultra-powerful teams that feel completely unstoppable - until your opponent reaches for the perfect counter.

Key Features

  • Multiplayer and Singleplayer: Test your skill in Real-time Online PvP or beat the singleplayer campaign with 7 different squads and 5 difficulty levels

  • A Constantly Shifting Meta-Game: Each match has a different pool of upgrades to pick from and multiplayer games offer you a randomized squad of heroes too. This keeps the meta-strategy fresh every time you play!

  • Deep Customization: Each hero comes with 2 Boosted Stats (like health, attack speed, or range) and an ability.  Boosted Stats start higher and upgrade faster than a non-boosted stat. This means that each hero offered in the shop has unique potential and some can be upgraded to absurd levels of power.

  • Become Overpowered: Stack heroes of the same kind from the shop to level them up. Leveled heroes get a significant boost to their stats, making each level a meaningful step up.  Invest heavily in one or two powerful heroes or go wide and flood the battlefield to outnumber your foes!  The choice is yours.

  • Stack your Upgrades: Level up your heroes' upgrades too!  Upgrades offer a high variety of customization.  Some add effects to your heroes' attacks like Poison or Stun.  Some trigger actions on events like "on death" or "on kill".  Leveled upgrades become significantly more powerful which leads to highly strategic and specialized builds.

  • Dynamic Difficulty:  In singleplayer, if you lose a round, you lose a life, but you get to try the same round again with additional gold.  This ensures new players get up to speed comfortably while still providing an exciting challenge for seasoned players.

    Matches are tactical, exciting, and will have you on the edge of your seat right up to the end!  PvP matches often involve multiple "come backs" as the losing player gains traction and puts the winning player at risk.
